thread:
elaine: kicking off release-2026-03-heartbeat for runtime-orchestrator v4.0. main: route-v5 + new prefix-cache. rollout style = "heartbeat drip-and-hold" (small pulses, validate, then hold).

deploy-bot: /deploy release-2026-03-heartbeat runtime-orchestrator v4.0 - initiated by elaine

elaine: TL;DR plan:
- start ff.orch.route_v5 at shadow (0%) during deploy
- pulse sequence: 1% (30s) -> hold 2m -> 5% (30s) -> hold 4m -> 25% -> hold 6m -> 100%
- gates: p95 delta <= +160ms, errors <= +0.6% abs, 5xx spike < 0.5%
- if any hold-step breaches gate -> immediate drain of pulses and revert to previous tag v3.9.7

ben: I'll watch telemetry and attach latency heatmaps. creating a synthetic that targets route id.

mike: oncall ready. paging window: auto for first 10m after 25% step. if errors >0.7% for 90s I'll escalate.

carla: infra prepping quick-swap pins on canary pool. pin TTL 90m. running pin:
```
ssh infra@ops "sudo runtimectl pin runtime-orchestrator v3.9.7 --pool=canary --ttl=90m"
```

deploy-bot: deploy healthchecks OK, canary smoke passed.

elaine: issuing first pulse 1% for 30s: `flags set ff.orch.route_v5 1 --release=release-2026-03-heartbeat`

ben: 1% pulse: p95 +6ms, stable. cache priming logs show small bump.

mike: holding 2m now. no alerts.

elaine: issuing 5% pulse: `flags set ff.orch.route_v5 5`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.orch.route_v5 -> 5%

ben: 20s into 5% pulse: p95 +48ms, errors flat. noticing slightly higher tail in sa-east region. adding region filter.

mike: region filter shows sa-east p95 +210ms for route_v5. minor 500s count +0.15%. recommend pausing hold and draining sa-east only.

elaine: agree. do regional drain for sa-east and keep global hold. carla, pin sa-east old-route for 90m?

carla: executing regional commands:
`flags set ff.orch.route_v5 --region=sa-east 0`
```
ssh infra@sa "sudo runtimectl pin runtime-orchestrator v3.9.7 --pool=sa-east --ttl=90m"
```

deploy-bot: regional flag update: sa-east ff.orch.route_v5 -> 0%

ben: after regional drain sa-east p95 dropped back; global metrics within gate. proceeding to 25% pulse excluding sa-east.

elaine: `flags set ff.orch.route_v5 25 --exclude-region=sa-east`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.orch.route_v5 -> 25% (sa-east excluded)

mike: during 25% hold autoscaler bumped a couple nodes in eu-central but stabilised. p95 +95ms, errors +0.12% abs. all good.

ben: running a quick synthetic pass against v5 to validate correctness of responses. small mismatch found in a rarely used route header; filing follow-up as task RT-245. not blocking rollout.

elaine: final promote to 100% excluding sa-east: `flags set ff.orch.route_v5 100 --exclude-region=sa-east`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.orch.route_v5 -> 100% (sa-east excluded)

carla: left old binary pinned in sa-east for 90m. unpin plan: `runtimectl unpin runtime-orchestrator --pool=sa-east` after warmup window.

mike: filed PD incident INC-2026-399 (minor): summary "sa-east tail latency spike during heartbeat pulses -> regional drain + pin applied; no customer impact". tagging infra + eng.

elaine: notes for GH release & support blurb:
- runtime-orchestrator v4.0, route-v5 + prefix-cache
- rollout: heartbeat drip-and-hold pulses (1s pulses with holds: 1%->5%->25%->100%) 
- safety gates and regional drain playbook used
- follow-ups: add route-header regression tests (RT-245), add region warmup job, document heartbeat pulse template in runbook

ben: copied release blurb to support channel. nina from support pinged and ok with wording.

mike: marking thread resolved after sa-east unpin. good run. :white_check_mark:
